Reveals whether a pool's liquidity geometry is mechanically stable or tilting toward one side.

Measures response amplitude, activation energy, chain reaction potential, catalytic/inhibitor bin detection, reaction order kinetics, equilibrium constants (Keq), and Le Chatelier self-correction index.

Helps LPs understand whether a pool's liquidity is dynamically responsive or sluggishly inert under trading pressure.
